name: Qiuse de Jiyi
source:
The protagonist (you) moved to Blue Tea County due to parent's work and transferred to a local high school Blue Tea College. In such a strange place you're going to meet different classmates and senior schoolmates, including a campus superstar, a boy able to communicate with cats and a bad luck guy. Knowing more from these fellows by conversation and your choices making, getting closer to them to get know their thoughts and secrets. What's happened on them before you came? While he opens his heart to you, you'll probably can't take him out of your mind. Falling in love is often almost imperceptibly.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/890070/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主人公（也就是你）因父母工作调动搬到蓝茶县，转入当地的蓝茶学院。在这个奇怪的地方，你会遇见形形色色的同学与学长，包括校园偶像、能与猫交流的男孩，以及一个倒霉鬼。通过交谈与选择，进一步了解这些人，接近他们，探寻思想与秘密。他们在你来到之前经历了什么？当他向你敞开心扉时，你或许也会无法将他从脑海中抹去。坠入爱河往往悄无声息。

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/890070/]Steam[/url]）
